title: 10k/10k Precision Voltage Divider
description: Code-as-hardware precision 1% resistive voltage divider with worst-case tolerance assertions, companion Resistor generic module, and ato.yaml build configuration.
code:
from "generics/resistors.ato" import Resistor

module VoltageDivider:
    signal v_in
    signal v_out
    signal gnd

    r_top = new Resistor
    r_bot = new Resistor
    r_top.resistance = 10kohm +/- 1%
    r_bot.resistance = 10kohm +/- 1%

    v_in ~> r_top ~> v_out
    v_out ~> r_bot ~> gnd

    assert r_top.resistance within 9.8kohm to 10.2kohm
    assert r_bot.resistance within 9.8kohm to 10.2kohm

title: RC Low-Pass Anti-Aliasing Filter
description: First-order analog anti-aliasing RC low-pass filter (fc = 15.9 kHz) for a 12-bit ADC front-end importing standard resistor and capacitor generic components.
code:
from "generics/resistors.ato" import Resistor
from "generics/capacitors.ato" import Capacitor

module AntiAliasingFilter:
    signal sig_in
    signal adc_in
    signal gnd

    r_series = new Resistor
    c_shunt = new Capacitor

    r_series.resistance = 1kohm +/- 1%
    c_shunt.capacitance = 10nF +/- 5%

    sig_in ~> r_series ~> adc_in
    adc_in ~> c_shunt ~> gnd

    assert r_series.resistance within 980ohm to 1020ohm
    assert c_shunt.capacitance within 9nF to 11nF

title: 3.3V LDO Linear Regulator Power Rail
description: 5V-to-3.3V low-dropout linear voltage regulator stage with input/output bulk decoupling capacitors, feedback divider resistors, and enable pull-up.
code:
from "generics/resistors.ato" import Resistor
from "generics/capacitors.ato" import Capacitor
from "generics/regulators.ato" import LDORegulator

module PowerRail3V3:
    signal v_5v
    signal v_3v3
    signal v_fb
    signal gnd

    u_ldo = new LDORegulator
    c_in = new Capacitor
    c_out = new Capacitor
    r_fb_top = new Resistor
    r_fb_bot = new Resistor

    c_in.capacitance = 10uF +/- 10%
    c_out.capacitance = 22uF +/- 10%
    r_fb_top.resistance = 31.6kohm +/- 1%
    r_fb_bot.resistance = 10kohm +/- 1%

    v_5v ~ u_ldo.v_in
    v_3v3 ~ u_ldo.v_out
    v_fb ~ u_ldo.fb
    gnd ~ u_ldo.gnd

    v_5v ~> c_in ~> gnd
    v_3v3 ~> c_out ~> gnd
    v_3v3 ~> r_fb_top ~> v_fb
    v_fb ~> r_fb_bot ~> gnd

    assert r_fb_top.resistance within 31kohm to 32.2kohm
    assert r_fb_bot.resistance within 9.8kohm to 10.2kohm

title: I2C Temperature Sensor Breakout with Bus Pull-Ups
description: Digital I2C temperature sensor breakout module wiring typed I2C and Power interfaces with 4.7 kOhm SDA/SCL pull-up resistors and local decoupling.
code:
from "generics/interfaces.ato" import I2C, Power
from "generics/resistors.ato" import Resistor

module TempSensorBreakout:
    power = new Power
    i2c = new I2C

    r_sda = new Resistor
    r_scl = new Resistor
    r_addr = new Resistor

    r_sda.resistance = 4.7kohm +/- 1%
    r_scl.resistance = 4.7kohm +/- 1%
    r_addr.resistance = 10kohm +/- 1%

    power.vcc ~> r_sda ~> i2c.sda
    power.vcc ~> r_scl ~> i2c.scl
    power.gnd ~> r_addr ~> power.vcc

    assert r_sda.resistance within 4.5kohm to 4.9kohm
    assert r_scl.resistance within 4.5kohm to 4.9kohm

title: USB-C Powered STM32 Telemetry Carrier Board
description: Multi-module Atopile hardware project combining a USB-C CC-pull-down front end (usb_c.ato), 3.3V power regulation stage (power.ato), shared passives library, and ato.yaml build manifest.
code:
from "usb_c.ato" import UsbCInput
from "power.ato" import PowerStage3V3
from "generics/passives.ato" import Resistor, Capacitor

module TelemetryCarrierBoard:
    signal vbus_5v
    signal vcc_3v3
    signal gnd
    signal can_tx
    signal can_rx

    usb = new UsbCInput
    pwr = new PowerStage3V3
    r_term = new Resistor
    c_dec = new Capacitor

    r_term.resistance = 120ohm +/- 1%
    c_dec.capacitance = 100nF +/- 10%

    usb.vbus ~ vbus_5v
    usb.gnd ~ gnd
    pwr.v_in ~ vbus_5v
    pwr.v_out ~ vcc_3v3
    pwr.gnd ~ gnd

    vcc_3v3 ~> c_dec ~> gnd
    can_tx ~> r_term ~> can_rx

    assert r_term.resistance within 115ohm to 125ohm
